rule: Additive only. No existing identity text, owner or digest changes; existing identities gain owners only through owner_additions.

new_acceptance_contracts.expectation: The visual-lock check fails naming the authority and token; nothing ships.
new_acceptance_contracts.proves: The two locked visual authorities cannot drift without a new owner lock.
new_acceptance_contracts.preconditions: Locked dark and light authority hashes recorded; visual-lock check wired into CI.
new_acceptance_contracts.stimulus: Change one byte of either authority image, or one derived token, with no new owner lock record.
new_acceptance_contracts.observable: The visual-lock check fails naming the authority and token; nothing ships.
new_acceptance_contracts.negative_case: A candidate that only changes non-authority surfaces passes.
new_acceptance_contracts.recovery_case: Reverting the change restores a green check.
new_acceptance_contracts.pass_evidence: Receipt bound to exact source commit, artifact/APK digest, configuration version and the induced input; reviewer readback of the refusal or restored state.

new_acceptance_contracts.expectation: Both themes render their locked tokens after each transition; no mixed-theme frame persists after settle.
new_acceptance_contracts.stimulus: Theme switch, process death and dynamic-type change on device.
new_acceptance_contracts.observable: Both themes render their locked tokens after each transition; no mixed-theme frame persists after settle.
new_acceptance_contracts.negative_case: A token mismatch after recreation fails.
new_acceptance_contracts.recovery_case: Recreation from saved state restores the selected authority.
new_acceptance_contracts.pass_evidence: Receipt bound to exact source commit, artifact/APK digest, configuration version and the induced input; reviewer readback of the refusal or restored state.

new_acceptance_contracts.expectation: Acceptance is refused with the digest mismatch named.
new_acceptance_contracts.proves: The owner's on-device decision binds the exact installed APK.
new_acceptance_contracts.preconditions: Owner acceptance record schema; Artemis capture of installed package digest.
new_acceptance_contracts.stimulus: Present an owner decision recorded against a different APK digest, or evidence from another build or device.
new_acceptance_contracts.observable: Acceptance is refused with the digest mismatch named.
new_acceptance_contracts.negative_case: Decision against the installed digest is accepted.
new_acceptance_contracts.recovery_case: Re-recording against the installed digest succeeds; the stale record stays as history.
new_acceptance_contracts.environment: S24 Ultra via authorized Artemis workflow
new_acceptance_contracts.pass_evidence: Receipt bound to exact source commit, artifact/APK digest, configuration version and the induced input; reviewer readback of the refusal or restored state.

new_acceptance_contracts.expectation: The REA gate refuses each, naming the record and reason.
new_acceptance_contracts.proves: Only admitted, hash-matching research inputs can justify architectural change.
new_acceptance_contracts.preconditions: RESEARCH_INPUT_ACCEPTANCE.json with 39 REA ids and hashes.
new_acceptance_contracts.stimulus: Cite a record outside the 39, a record whose bytes no longer hash to the admitted value, or a static-only record as runtime/device evidence.
new_acceptance_contracts.observable: The REA gate refuses each, naming the record and reason.
new_acceptance_contracts.negative_case: An admitted, matching record used within its declared limits passes.
new_acceptance_contracts.recovery_case: Re-admission with a new hash restores eligibility; dependants are re-checked.
new_acceptance_contracts.pass_evidence: Receipt bound to exact source commit, artifact/APK digest, configuration version and the induced input; reviewer readback of the refusal or restored state.

new_acceptance_contracts.expectation: Dependent changes are marked for re-admission and cannot be cited until re-checked.
new_acceptance_contracts.proves: Superseding a research record invalidates what depended on it.
new_acceptance_contracts.preconditions: A change admitted on REA record R.
new_acceptance_contracts.stimulus: Supersede R with a new version.
new_acceptance_contracts.observable: Dependent changes are marked for re-admission and cannot be cited until re-checked.
new_acceptance_contracts.negative_case: A dependant still citing old R passes: fails.
new_acceptance_contracts.recovery_case: Re-admission of dependants clears the mark.
new_acceptance_contracts.pass_evidence: Receipt bound to exact source commit, artifact/APK digest, configuration version and the induced input; reviewer readback of the refusal or restored state.

new_acceptance_contracts.expectation: Old credential stays valid and in use after a failed verify or crash; the attempt is recorded; a server/login change forces re-verification before any trading.
new_acceptance_contracts.proves: Credential rotation never leaves an account without valid credentials (master inherited §7.9.10).
new_acceptance_contracts.preconditions: Linked account with a working credential; fault injection on verify and swap.
new_acceptance_contracts.stimulus: Fail verification of the new secret; crash between verify and swap; change server/login.
new_acceptance_contracts.observable: Old credential stays valid and in use after a failed verify or crash; the attempt is recorded; a server/login change forces re-verification before any trading.
new_acceptance_contracts.negative_case: A successful rotation destroys the old secret with a receipt.
new_acceptance_contracts.recovery_case: Restart after a crash resumes from the recorded attempt without a credential gap.
new_acceptance_contracts.pass_evidence: Receipt bound to exact source commit, artifact/APK digest, configuration version and the induced input; reviewer readback of the refusal or restored state.

new_acceptance_contracts.expectation: Each is refused and audited; the stored goal is unchanged.
new_acceptance_contracts.proves: Only the owner can change learning goals, within recorded consent.
new_acceptance_contracts.preconditions: Memory learning goals with revision ids; consent record.
new_acceptance_contracts.stimulus: Edit from a non-owner principal; edit against a stale revision; goal widening data use beyond consent.
new_acceptance_contracts.observable: Each is refused and audited; the stored goal is unchanged.
new_acceptance_contracts.negative_case: An owner edit on the current revision within consent is applied and audited.
new_acceptance_contracts.recovery_case: None required beyond audit; see REC.
new_acceptance_contracts.pass_evidence: Receipt bound to exact source commit, artifact/APK digest, configuration version and the induced input; reviewer readback of the refusal or restored state.

new_acceptance_contracts.expectation: Exactly one audited revision wins; restart shows the last committed goal.
new_acceptance_contracts.proves: Goal edits are durable and single-valued.
new_acceptance_contracts.preconditions: Two concurrent owner edits; process restart.
new_acceptance_contracts.stimulus: Submit two edits concurrently, then restart.
new_acceptance_contracts.observable: Exactly one audited revision wins; restart shows the last committed goal.
new_acceptance_contracts.negative_case: Both edits applied or a lost edit with no audit: fails.
new_acceptance_contracts.pass_evidence: Receipt bound to exact source commit, artifact/APK digest, configuration version and the induced input; reviewer readback of the refusal or restored state.
